name: axle-a11y
description: Scan any URL — or your localhost dev server — for WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility violations from inside VS Code, then click a violation for an AI-suggested code fix. Powered by axe-core 4.11.

commands.title: axle: Scan a URL for WCAG violations
axle: Generate AI fix for a violation from the last scan

axle.defaultUrl.description: URL to scan when running 'axle: Scan localhost dev server'. Local and private-network URLs are scanned on your machine with axle-cli.

axle.failOn.description: Lowest severity shown in the main list. Issues below it are not dropped — they are collapsed under "lower-severity issues". "none" shows everything.

axle.apiKey.description: Optional axle API key (any paid plan). Lifts the free daily limit on AI fixes. Stored in your user settings, never in the workspace.

axle.showCiTip.description: Occasionally (at most weekly, never on your first scan) suggest running axle in CI after a scan that found issues.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Scanning a localhost/private URL runs `npx axle-cli` on your machine, so it is disabled until you trust the workspace. Scanning public URLs and generating AI fixes work in any workspace.
